hooks.name: KiroGraph Sync on Delete
hooks.description: Remove deleted files from the KiroGraph index. Only marks the index dirty — the actual sync is deferred to the Stop hook, because every sync costs ~3-4 min (full scan + global symbol resolve) and running it inline on each delete would both block and collide with a sync already in flight. Writes the marker directly (same content kirograph's LockManager.markDirty writes, String(Date.now())) instead of spawning node: 4 ms vs 1.18 s per save, measured 2026-10-05.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0; [ -d .kirograph ] && date +%s%3N >.kirograph/dirty 2>/dev/null; exit 0
